In the right place you get a few more rare fish and faster bites, a bit less in the wrong one. All rods you own are in the "Bag" to switch anytime.

Each cast has about a 0.15% chance of meeting it, and the event ends when someone catches it. The catcher may release it for 💙50 Sea Love points; if the event isn't over it returns to the pond for others. The counter shows roughly when the next one is.
🎣 看浮標：魚咬之前會先「試探」—— 小魚群會點很多下、中大型魚重重點一下、掠食: 🎣 Reading the float: fish "test" before biting — small schools tap many times, medium-large fish give one heavy tap, predators (marlin, tuna, sharks) drag the float away without testing, bottom fish (grouper, crab) push the float up, and sly ones like mahi-mahi and squid tap once then pause a long time. Pressing during a test scares the fish; wait until the float sinks fully, the phone buzzes and "!" appears, then press "Strike". A fish comes within about 8 seconds at most.

Rowing near whales: they dive under the boat; if you stay still a humpback may swim over curiously, circle you, turn on its side for a look and finally blow beside the boat (there's an achievement); dolphins race ahead of your bow. Splashes and spouts leave the screen wet.

🚢 深海三層：潛水艇從有陽光的淺海出發。0～200 公尺是☀️ 透光層（藍綠色、: 🚢 Three deep-sea layers: the submarine starts in sunlit shallows. 0–200 m is the ☀️ sunlight zone (blue-green, with light shafts from above and ripples of light on the sand); 200–1000 m is the 🌘 twilight zone (darker and darker, no light shafts below 600 m); below 1000 m is the 🌑 midnight zone (pitch black, only the submarine's lights and glowing creatures). Marine snow drifts down all the way. Back in the sunlight zone, the music turns bright again.
🌿 紅樹林：在本島南岸、南方沙灘再往南，從岸上走進去就到了（地圖下方深綠色那一片: 🌿 Mangroves: on the main island's south coast, south of South Beach; just walk in from the shore (the dark green area at the bottom of the map). At rising tide fish swim among the roots; from the Mangrove Pier's glowing ring or the bank you can catch mullet, milkfish, scat and black bream, and with luck barramundi, bull shark and sawfish. At low tide the mudflat by the island is exposed and you can walk down: nudge the joystick to creep up on mudskippers or fiddler crabs, then press "Grab!". Running scares them off, and you must return to the island fast when the water rises.

Total stars show at the top of the Fishdex; 50, 150, 300 and 450 stars give titles, and the ranking has "Fishdex stars".
🧒 兒童安全模式（給家長看）：第一次進遊戲會問出生年份（只問年，不問真名、生日）: 🧒 Child safety mode (for parents): the first launch asks for a birth year (year only, no real name or birthday). Under 13 it turns on automatically and can't be turned off by the child: chat uses fixed quick phrases only and others' typed text is hidden; the message board can be read but not posted to; names are chosen from "adjective + animal"; friends can be added only by a friend code given in person, not directly by strangers; the Designer Market shows only widely bought, unreported works; deep-sea scare effects are off by default; no email is requested.
🔭 深海目擊：開潛水艇有時候會遇到特別的事——淺海被幾百條小魚圍成一顆球；午夜層: 🔭 Deep-sea sightings: the submarine sometimes meets special things — hundreds of small fish balling up around you in the shallows; pressing "🔦 Light off" in the midnight zone to see glowing life (half battery use while off); a red dot on the sonar if you stay too long in the dark…; a warm little light far away; a sperm whale passing overhead. At most one every 90 seconds; each first sighting is logged under "Deep-sea sightings" in the Fishdex and gives 💙30 Sea Love points. They only startle: no battery or fish is lost and the submarine isn't damaged; if you're scared, turn off "Deep-sea scare effects" in Settings.
🎨 自己設計衣服：在「造型」分頁選「衣服」或「褲子」等，最下面按「＋ 自己設計」: 🎨 Design your own clothes: in the "Style" tab choose "Clothes", "Pants" etc. and press "+ Design your own" at the bottom to draw on a 32×32 grid with 48 colors (tops have a front and back; tools include line, box, fill, color picker, mirror, thin and thick brushes, undo and redo, or your own image), then save to wear it. 🧰 裝備改變手感：硬竿（遠投竿）—— 做對時魚掉更多體力，但魚的動作更快、提示更: 🧰 Gear changes the feel: stiff rods (long-cast) — correct moves drain more stamina, but fish move faster and prompts are shorter; soft rods (pole, rock) — more forgiving (looser timing, smaller tension spikes when forcing), with longer prompts; casting rods are in between. Thick line rarely snaps, but fish are warier and test longer before biting; thin line gets quick tests but snaps easily. Bait decides which sign's fish you attract: earthworm (worm bait) → 🫧 bottom fish, live bait (made by Master Atie) → 🐦 predators; that type bites more easily, with a bigger, wider bonus beside the matching sign.
在商店街入口西邊的寵物店（小花）可以領養：貓、柴犬、水獺、海鷗、寄居蟹，每一種都: Adopt at the Pet Shop (Xiaohua) west of the shopping street entrance: cat, Shiba, otter, seagull and hermit crab, each in several patterns (random; ⭐ is very rare). Baby sea turtles, small octopuses and puffers are only scooped up now and then while fishing at the shore, harbor, reef or mangroves; otter pups sometimes by creeks and lakes. Pets can be sold on the "🏷️ Pet Market" (seller gets 90%; the buyer rebuilds bond). Up to 3 pets each, 1 out at a time; the others stay on your island where visiting friends can see them. Names up to 8 characters.
🍽️ 針對特定魚的餌（愛吃的魚 ×1.8，其他魚少一點）：🌽 玉米粒（鯽魚、鯉魚: 🍽️ Baits for specific fish (favorite fish ×1.8, others a bit fewer): 🌽 corn (omnivores like crucian carp and carp), bloodworms (small creek fish), 🍞 bread dough (tilapia, surface fish), 🦐 peeled shrimp (breams) and krill (mackerel, scad, sardine) are sold at the Tackle Shop; 🪱 sandworms are dug on the beach at low tide and 🦀 small crabs picked on the reef island rocks (6 times a day each); 🔪 saury chunks are made by Master Atie; ✨ sea-sparkle bait is Dr. Wei's request reward. 👀 看水面再拋：釣點前面的水面會出現徵兆，每 45 秒換一批 —— 〰️ 一圈圈: 👀 Read the water before casting: signs appear on the water in front of a spot, changing every 45 seconds — 〰️ rings of ripples are small schools, 🌑 a dark shadow underwater is a medium-large fish, 🐦 circling seabirds mean predators (marlin, mahi-mahi, tuna and the like), 🫧 a string of bubbles means bottom fish (grouper, crab, catfish and the like). While holding "Cast", slide your finger left or right to aim (A/D on a computer); the yellow ring on the water is where it will land. Walk close to a sign and it's labeled with the fish type. Land the float beside a sign and that type bites more easily; landing right on it scares the fish, so cast a little to the side.
🔧 阿鐵師傅（釣具店旁邊）：帶魚和金幣去，可以做活餌（吸引掠食魚）、鉤子（倒刺鉤: 🔧 Master Atie (beside the Tackle Shop): bring fish and coins to make live bait (attracts predators), hooks (barbed hook: fewer slips on slack line｜circle hook: each fish forgives one mistake｜forged heavy hook: tension rises slowly when forcing｜gold hook: correct moves drain more stamina), rod styles (bamboo grain, wood grain, red-white stripes, wave, coral, carbon fiber, gold leaf, rainbow) and line colors (red, neon yellow, neon green, pink, glow blue, gold). It uses the lightest tank fish of that rarity, never favorites ⭐, displayed fish or variants; up to 10 a day. Press "Equip" when done; others can see it. Cosmetic only, no effect on fishing.
⚔️ 怎麼對付魚的動作：拉魚的時候魚會輪流做動作，動作前畫面中間會先跳出黃色的提: ⚔️ Countering fish moves: during a fight the fish performs moves in turn; a yellow prompt pops up mid-screen first (about half a second), then turns red telling you what to do — 💨 Dash: release and don't reel until it's done｜😮‍💨 Stops to pant: tap the button rapidly (the most line is gained now)｜⬅➡ Darts left/right: pull the joystick the opposite way｜⬆️ Jumps: release, reel after it lands｜⬇️ Dives: hold but not at full power, keeping the tension bar in the middle｜🪨 Wraps on rocks (only at rocky places): release and wait 3 s for it to swim free; forcing snaps the line. Correct moves drain lots of stamina and add +1 combo.
🐋 海上目擊：外海（離岸 40 公尺以上的深水）任何地方都可能突然遇到海豚群、座: 🐋 Sea sightings: anywhere offshore (deep water 40 m+ from land) you may suddenly meet a dolphin pod, humpback, blue or sperm whale (uncommon: about one whale per 20 minutes of rowing offshore), with no warning; often you first hear the "pfff—ssss" of a blow. Everyone sees the same animal doing the same thing. Humpbacks breach and slap tail and flippers; blue whales breathe a few times then dive deep; sperm whales rest floating at the surface, spouting at a forward-left angle. When a whale is up, 📷 appears on the right for photos. Each first encounter is logged under "Sea sightings" in the Fishdex and gives 💙30 Sea Love points. They never hit boats or make you lose anything.
🦈 赤紅霸王鯊：外海深處住著一小群紅色的鯊魚，整個伺服器共用，一開始只有一公一母: 🦈 Crimson King Shark: a small group of red sharks lives in the deep open sea, shared by the whole server, starting with one male and one female. If not caught, each pair (male and female) has a 50% chance every 7 days of a pup (a very few are albino). They roam mainly off the harbor and sometimes the deep water beyond the Coral Reef Islands (even lower odds) (up to 8 sharks); more sharks means easier encounters, but still extremely rare. Even hooked, it usually breaks free, gaining a cross each time, and more crosses make it harder to land. A caught red shark can't be sold or gifted; releasing it gives 💙100 Sea Love points; if all are caught they go extinct.
♂♀ 公母和繁殖：每條魚都有公母（卡片、魚缸會顯示 ♂／♀）。春天和夏天是野外繁: ♂♀ Sexes and breeding: every fish is male or female (cards and the tank show ♂/♀). Spring and summer are the wild breeding season, when self-breeding fish such as tilapia, crucian carp, topmouth gudgeon, medaka, mudskippers, fiddler crabs and crayfish are more common, with more young; tilapia nests appear on the shallow bottom of Moonbay Riverbank, and if the float lands by a nest the guarding male strikes at once. Some female tilapia carry fry in their mouths (🐣); releasing them gives 💙5 more. A male and female of one species on display in the aquarium may have fry each day (🍼, up to 3 a day); breeders include goldfish, koi, carp, crucian carp, tilapia, clownfish, medaka, river prawn, crayfish, seahorse, loach and topmouth gudgeon.
🐢 小烏龜（斑龜）：在寵物店小花那裡領養，或在河邊、池塘釣魚偶爾撿到被棄養的小烏: 🐢 Little turtle (striped turtle): adopt from Xiaohua at the Pet Shop, or sometimes find an abandoned one while fishing rivers and ponds (a pet is for life; turtles can live for decades). In "Pets" press "🧽 Care": ☀️ basking on the island rocks on sunny days works best, 🥬 a balanced diet daily (pellets, leafy greens and small fish in rotation), 🥚 egg yolk as a treat once a week, 🧽 change the water and scrub the shell to keep it shiny, 🧴 shell care at most once a month. At shine 80 patterns appear on the shell, at 100 a golden rim, and the next day's Tide Village News features "This week's prettiest turtle". Real turtles are the same: a beautiful shell comes from basking (UV), calcium, a balanced diet and clean water. Baby sea turtles are protected: photograph them and return them to the sea.

🪸 小島海底花園：小島碼頭左邊有一座潛水梯（有紅色救生圈），有潛水裝備就可以下去: 🪸 Island sea garden: there is a dive ladder (with a red life ring) on the left side of your island pier. With diving gear you can go down to the seabed under your island . Hold a sea seed (kelp 3 h, sea grapes 8 h, coral 36 h, pearl oyster 48 h; buy them at the garden's seed stall), swim to any spot on the seabed and tap "Plant": you can plant anywhere, even close together. Sea crops need no watering and grow in real time; the more that are at least half grown, the more schools of fish come for you to photograph. Coral also attracts reef fish: each coral that is at least half grown gives +25% parrotfish, seahorse and lionfish (the rare reef fish) when you fish at an island (up to 4 corals, so at most double). Friends who dive from the same island can see each other underwater. You can grow 4 plants at first and pay coins to expand to 8, 12 and 16. Build your own seabed: the seed stall sells scenery (pink, orange and purple coral, brain coral, seagrass, kelp forest, anemone, sponge, starfish, shell, small and big rocks, white sand) and decorations (old amphora, bubble rock, giant clam, old anchor, stone lantern, treasure chest, stone head, stone arch). They go into your bag; dive down, hold one and tap "Place": it goes right in front of you and you can pack them side by side; go near one and tap "Put away" to take it back. Up to 300 pieces in total, and housemates or family who live with you can decorate together. Crops that you harvest for coins are counted separately and still have a limit. When you dive at someone else's island you can like their seabed (once a week); the bottom of the "Sea garden" page shows the "🏆 Most beautiful seabed this week" ranking, reset every Monday, with a "Visit" button. You can also dive at a friend's island to visit their sea garden.

🌊 海浪和潮汐：海上有一排一排的浪往岸邊推，越靠岸越白；下雨浪比較大，暴風雨最大: 🌊 Waves and tides: rows of waves roll toward the shore and turn whiter as they get close. Rain makes them bigger, storms the biggest with whitecaps all over the sea, and fog the calmest. At high tide the sea washes up over the sand (you splash when you walk in it); at low tide it pulls back and leaves wet sand, and little crabs come out and scuttle sideways, diving back into the sand when you get close. There are shells, starfish and seaweed on the beach. Near the sea you can hear the waves come in one by one. The first few metres off the shore are a gentle shallow shelf, so at low tide the sea pulls back several metres; on the shelf there are flat rocks that show up whole at low tide, with a tide pool on top. The mangroves and the coral island also have waves at their shores. At low tide your float will not land on the exposed sand; it is cast a little farther automatically. Villagers who live by the sea sometimes mention the tide. Rivers, lakes and ponds do not rise or fall.

Tap the weather at the top right to see the forecast with the next landfall time. A warning goes out one hour before landfall, and fish bite especially hard then. During the 40 minutes of landfall you can't take boats, dive or use the submarine; fishing from shore at Sunny Tide Beach or the Harbor can catch deep-sea fish thrown up by the waves, legends are much more common, but the line pulls hard. For an hour afterwards the sky clears with a rainbow and 12 things wash up on the beaches (driftwood, shells, glass floats, a chest): walk up and tap Pick, once each, for coins or ocean points. A typhoon never damages anything of yours.

🛡️ 虎鯨和座頭鯨：流冰海岸（冰封群島西邊）的流冰外面，大約每一個多小時會有三隻: 🛡️ Orcas and humpbacks: beyond the ice floes off the Drift Ice Coast (west of the frozen islands), three orcas come hunting about once every hour or so, for around two minutes; you can watch from the shore at the drift-ice spot. Sometimes they circle a humpback mother and calf, and the mother keeps the calf at her side and drives them off with fin and tail slaps; sometimes they circle a seal on a floe and a humpback comes charging in from afar to block them. This really happens: orcas hunt humpback calves, and adult humpbacks are among the few animals that fight back. The orcas always give up and no animal is hurt. Everyone sees the same scene.

At night, more than 6 m from a lit campfire and not in your cabin, you get cold; in rain without a shelter or cabin overhead you get soaked (storms are worse) — both drain stamina. When you're fed (50+) and nothing is draining, stamina slowly recovers. 看浮標：魚咬之前會先「試探」—— 小魚群會點很多下、中大型魚重重點一下、掠食魚（: Reading the float: fish "test" before biting — small schools tap many times, medium-large fish give one heavy tap, predators (marlin, tuna, sharks) drag the float away without testing, bottom fish (grouper, crab) push the float up, and sly ones like mahi-mahi and squid tap once then pause a long time. Pressing during a test scares the fish; wait until the float sinks fully, the phone buzzes and "!" appears, then press "Strike". A fish comes within about 8 seconds at most.

Rowing near whales: they dive under the boat; if you stay still a humpback may swim over curiously, circle you, turn on its side for a look and finally blow beside the boat (there's an achievement); dolphins race ahead of your bow. Splashes and spouts leave the screen wet.

Total stars show at the top of the Fishdex; 50, 150, 300 and 450 stars give titles, and the ranking has "Fishdex stars".
兒童安全模式（給家長看）：第一次進遊戲會問出生年份（只問年，不問真名、生日）。未: Child safety mode (for parents): the first launch asks for a birth year (year only, no real name or birthday). Under 13 it turns on automatically and can't be turned off by the child: chat uses fixed quick phrases only and others' typed text is hidden; the message board can be read but not posted to; names are chosen from "adjective + animal"; friends can be added only by a friend code given in person, not directly by strangers; the Designer Market shows only widely bought, unreported works; deep-sea scare effects are off by default; no email is requested.
深海目擊：開潛水艇有時候會遇到特別的事——淺海被幾百條小魚圍成一顆球；午夜層按「: Deep-sea sightings: the submarine sometimes meets special things — hundreds of small fish balling up around you in the shallows; pressing "🔦 Light off" in the midnight zone to see glowing life (half battery use while off); a red dot on the sonar if you stay too long in the dark…; a warm little light far away; a sperm whale passing overhead. At most one every 90 seconds; each first sighting is logged under "Deep-sea sightings" in the Fishdex and gives 💙30 Sea Love points. They only startle: no battery or fish is lost and the submarine isn't damaged; if you're scared, turn off "Deep-sea scare effects" in Settings.
自己設計衣服：在「造型」分頁選「衣服」或「褲子」等，最下面按「＋ 自己設計」，就: Design your own clothes: in the "Style" tab choose "Clothes", "Pants" etc. and press "+ Design your own" at the bottom to draw on a 32×32 grid with 48 colors (tops have a front and back; tools include line, box, fill, color picker, mirror, thin and thick brushes, undo and redo, or your own image), then save to wear it. Designs go on the "🛍️ Designer Market" at your price, and you get 90% when someone buys. Hats, shoes, capes and scarves can be designed too, with no limit on count; inappropriate images are unlisted after three reports.
裝備改變手感：硬竿（遠投竿）—— 做對時魚掉更多體力，但魚的動作更快、提示更短；: Gear changes the feel: stiff rods (long-cast) — correct moves drain more stamina, but fish move faster and prompts are shorter; soft rods (pole, rock) — more forgiving (looser timing, smaller tension spikes when forcing), with longer prompts; casting rods are in between. Thick line rarely snaps, but fish are warier and test longer before biting; thin line gets quick tests but snaps easily. Bait decides which sign's fish you attract: earthworm (worm bait) → 🫧 bottom fish, live bait (made by Master Atie) → 🐦 predators; that type bites more easily, with a bigger, wider bonus beside the matching sign.

Once equipped, the top right lists which fish at this spot love it. Fish you've caught 10 of (★★) show "Favorite bait" in the Fishdex.
看水面再拋：釣點前面的水面會出現徵兆，每 45 秒換一批 —— 〰️ 一圈圈漣漪: Read the water before casting: signs appear on the water in front of a spot, changing every 45 seconds — 〰️ rings of ripples are small schools, 🌑 a dark shadow underwater is a medium-large fish, 🐦 circling seabirds mean predators (marlin, mahi-mahi, tuna and the like), 🫧 a string of bubbles means bottom fish (grouper, crab, catfish and the like). While holding "Cast", slide your finger left or right to aim (A/D on a computer); the yellow ring on the water is where it will land. Walk close to a sign and it's labeled with the fish type. Land the float beside a sign and that type bites more easily; landing right on it scares the fish, so cast a little to the side.
阿鐵師傅（釣具店旁邊）：帶魚和金幣去，可以做活餌（吸引掠食魚）、鉤子（倒刺鉤：線: Master Atie (beside the Tackle Shop): bring fish and coins to make live bait (attracts predators), hooks (barbed hook: fewer slips on slack line｜circle hook: each fish forgives one mistake｜forged heavy hook: tension rises slowly when forcing｜gold hook: correct moves drain more stamina), rod styles (bamboo grain, wood grain, red-white stripes, wave, coral, carbon fiber, gold leaf, rainbow) and line colors (red, neon yellow, neon green, pink, glow blue, gold). It uses the lightest tank fish of that rarity, never favorites ⭐, displayed fish or variants; up to 10 a day. Press "Equip" when done; others can see it. Cosmetic only, no effect on fishing.
怎麼對付魚的動作：拉魚的時候魚會輪流做動作，動作前畫面中間會先跳出黃色的提示（大: Countering fish moves: during a fight the fish performs moves in turn; a yellow prompt pops up mid-screen first (about half a second), then turns red telling you what to do — 💨 Dash: release and don't reel until it's done｜😮‍💨 Stops to pant: tap the button rapidly (the most line is gained now)｜⬅➡ Darts left/right: pull the joystick the opposite way｜⬆️ Jumps: release, reel after it lands｜⬇️ Dives: hold but not at full power, keeping the tension bar in the middle｜🪨 Wraps on rocks (only at rocky places): release and wait 3 s for it to swim free; forcing snaps the line. Correct moves drain lots of stamina and add +1 combo.
海上目擊：外海（離岸 40 公尺以上的深水）任何地方都可能突然遇到海豚群、座頭鯨: Sea sightings: anywhere offshore (deep water 40 m+ from land) you may suddenly meet a dolphin pod, humpback, blue or sperm whale (uncommon: about one whale per 20 minutes of rowing offshore), with no warning; often you first hear the "pfff—ssss" of a blow. Everyone sees the same animal doing the same thing. Humpbacks breach and slap tail and flippers; blue whales breathe a few times then dive deep; sperm whales rest floating at the surface, spouting at a forward-left angle. When a whale is up, 📷 appears on the right for photos. Each first encounter is logged under "Sea sightings" in the Fishdex and gives 💙30 Sea Love points. They never hit boats or make you lose anything.
赤紅霸王鯊：外海深處住著一小群紅色的鯊魚，整個伺服器共用，一開始只有一公一母。沒: Crimson King Shark: a small group of red sharks lives in the deep open sea, shared by the whole server, starting with one male and one female. If not caught, each pair (male and female) has a 50% chance every 7 days of a pup (a very few are albino). They roam mainly off the harbor and sometimes the deep water beyond the Coral Reef Islands (even lower odds) (up to 8 sharks); more sharks means easier encounters, but still extremely rare. Even hooked, it usually breaks free, gaining a cross each time, and more crosses make it harder to land. A caught red shark can't be sold or gifted; releasing it gives 💙100 Sea Love points; if all are caught they go extinct.
公母和繁殖：每條魚都有公母（卡片、魚缸會顯示 ♂／♀）。春天和夏天是野外繁殖季，: Sexes and breeding: every fish is male or female (cards and the tank show ♂/♀). Spring and summer are the wild breeding season, when self-breeding fish such as tilapia, crucian carp, topmouth gudgeon, medaka, mudskippers, fiddler crabs and crayfish are more common, with more young; tilapia nests appear on the shallow bottom of Moonbay Riverbank, and if the float lands by a nest the guarding male strikes at once. Some female tilapia carry fry in their mouths (🐣); releasing them gives 💙5 more. A male and female of one species on display in the aquarium may have fry each day (🍼, up to 3 a day); breeders include goldfish, koi, carp, crucian carp, tilapia, clownfish, medaka, river prawn, crayfish, seahorse, loach and topmouth gudgeon.
小烏龜（斑龜）：在寵物店小花那裡領養，或在河邊、池塘釣魚偶爾撿到被棄養的小烏龜（: Little turtle (striped turtle): adopt from Xiaohua at the Pet Shop, or sometimes find an abandoned one while fishing rivers and ponds (a pet is for life; turtles can live for decades). In "Pets" press "🧽 Care": ☀️ basking on the island rocks on sunny days works best, 🥬 a balanced diet daily (pellets, leafy greens and small fish in rotation), 🥚 egg yolk as a treat once a week, 🧽 change the water and scrub the shell to keep it shiny, 🧴 shell care at most once a month. At shine 80 patterns appear on the shell, at 100 a golden rim, and the next day's Tide Village News features "This week's prettiest turtle". Real turtles are the same: a beautiful shell comes from basking (UV), calcium, a balanced diet and clean water. Baby sea turtles are protected: photograph them and return them to the sea.

Tabs at the top of each switch pages. The small strip under the buttons shows time, weather and tide. On the left is the small "Today" list (collapsible); below is the chat bar, with 📜 chat log on its left (what everyone said, kept 24 hours on this phone) and 😀 for emotes and playing with pets. When idle, the big bottom-right button is "Go fishing", which leads you to the nearest spot with the same arrow and light beam.

小島海底花園：小島碼頭左邊有一座潛水梯（有紅色救生圈），有潛水裝備就可以下去自己: Island sea garden: there is a dive ladder (with a red life ring) on the left side of your island pier. With diving gear you can go down to the seabed under your island . Hold a sea seed (kelp 3 h, sea grapes 8 h, coral 36 h, pearl oyster 48 h; buy them at the garden's seed stall), swim to any spot on the seabed and tap "Plant": you can plant anywhere, even close together. Sea crops need no watering and grow in real time; the more that are at least half grown, the more schools of fish come for you to photograph. Coral also attracts reef fish: each coral that is at least half grown gives +25% parrotfish, seahorse and lionfish (the rare reef fish) when you fish at an island (up to 4 corals, so at most double). Friends who dive from the same island can see each other underwater. You can grow 4 plants at first and pay coins to expand to 8, 12 and 16. Build your own seabed: the seed stall sells scenery (pink, orange and purple coral, brain coral, seagrass, kelp forest, anemone, sponge, starfish, shell, small and big rocks, white sand) and decorations (old amphora, bubble rock, giant clam, old anchor, stone lantern, treasure chest, stone head, stone arch). They go into your bag; dive down, hold one and tap "Place": it goes right in front of you and you can pack them side by side; go near one and tap "Put away" to take it back. Up to 300 pieces in total, and housemates or family who live with you can decorate together. Crops that you harvest for coins are counted separately and still have a limit. When you dive at someone else's island you can like their seabed (once a week); the bottom of the "Sea garden" page shows the "🏆 Most beautiful seabed this week" ranking, reset every Monday, with a "Visit" button. You can also dive at a friend's island to visit their sea garden.

海浪和潮汐：海上有一排一排的浪往岸邊推，越靠岸越白；下雨浪比較大，暴風雨最大、整: Waves and tides: rows of waves roll toward the shore and turn whiter as they get close. Rain makes them bigger, storms the biggest with whitecaps all over the sea, and fog the calmest. At high tide the sea washes up over the sand (you splash when you walk in it); at low tide it pulls back and leaves wet sand, and little crabs come out and scuttle sideways, diving back into the sand when you get close. There are shells, starfish and seaweed on the beach. Near the sea you can hear the waves come in one by one. The first few metres off the shore are a gentle shallow shelf, so at low tide the sea pulls back several metres; on the shelf there are flat rocks that show up whole at low tide, with a tide pool on top. The mangroves and the coral island also have waves at their shores. At low tide your float will not land on the exposed sand; it is cast a little farther automatically. Villagers who live by the sea sometimes mention the tide. Rivers, lakes and ponds do not rise or fall.

While reeling the rod bends with tension (tighter = more bend), and while you hold to reel the handle turns and clicks. On a catch the rod lifts, the fish swings on the long line under the tip, the line is drawn in until the fish dangles before you, then your hand reaches out to pick it up — one hand for small fish, both hands with the rod put down for big ones — and only then the weight appears. Your hands' skin tone and sleeves match your character. After viewing the fish you stay in first person as long as you stand still (casting again doesn't switch back and forth); walking, sitting or boarding a boat returns to the behind view. You can switch back to "Behind" in Settings any time. First person isn't used for the Boss Fish, diving or indoors.

Campfire (5 driftwood + 3 stones), shelter (8 driftwood + 6 big leaves + 2 rope) and cabin (20 driftwood + 10 bamboo + 12 big leaves + 6 rope + 6 stones) are made first and kept in the island bag, then you walk to where you want them: a see-through preview follows you; on a green ring press the big button "Place here" and your character hammers away for a few seconds. A red ring says why it can't go there; tap "Not now" at the top right to keep it, and use "Place" in the island bag later. Grass and driftwood on the spot are cleared; you can't build next to palms, bamboo, big rocks, on steep ground or in front of the pier. 荒島求生：在漂流島上左上角會出現飽足度和體力（點一下打開荒島背包）。飽足度每 9: Island survival: on Driftwood Isle, fullness and stamina bars appear at the top left (tap to open the island bag). Fullness drops 1 every 9 seconds; at 0, stamina starts dropping. At night, more than 6 m from a lit campfire and not in your cabin, you get cold; in rain without a shelter or cabin overhead you get soaked (storms are worse) — both drain stamina. When you're fed (50+) and nothing is draining, stamina slowly recovers. Eat from the island bag: coconut +10, raw small fish +8, grilled small fish +20, raw small crab +5, grilled crab +12; fish leave a bone (2 bones make a bone hook). At low tide, the tide pools on the east beach have small fish and crabs (you can see little fish swimming in them); at high tide the pools are under seawater, so wait for low tide. Stand by a lit fire and press "Grill". Sleep in your cabin bed: stamina recovers fast and you stay warm at night, but it doesn't make morning come sooner (the whole village shares one clock). At 0 stamina you collapse: half of your island bag is lost (rods and hooks are kept); you wake in your cabin if you have one, otherwise A-Hai brings you back to the harbor. Lie on your own bed at home for 5 seconds and your next island trip has 120 max stamina. Press "Back to village" at the end of the pier to sail home.

釣魚裝備：釣具店「🧰工具」可以買摺疊椅（🪙600）、小釣台（🪙1500）、竿架＋: Fishing gear: the tackle shop's "🧰 Tools" sells a folding chair (🪙600), fishing platform (🪙1500), rod holder + keepnet (🪙900) and umbrella + tackle box (🪙800); the last three need the chair first. They go in Bag → "🎣 Rig". Stand at the water facing it and tap "Set up": the gear goes on the shore in front of you and you sit down, so you can cast and reel while seated. With the platform, the chair sits at the end of a deck over the water and you cast about 3 m farther. With the rod holder, tap "Jump" while waiting to stand up: the rod stays in the holder and you can do other things; when a fish bites the bell rings and the tip shakes, and you have 25 seconds to sit back down and reel, or the fish takes the bait. The keepnet sits in the water and the fish you catch this time swim in it. The umbrella stands next to the chair, and the tackle box (in Bag → "🎣 Rig") lets you buy bait on the spot. Walk 15 m away, board a boat, dive or tap "Pack up" and it all goes back into your bag. Others see your gear and the fish in your keepnet. Gear doesn't change your chances of rare fish.

搏鬥打法：每種魚屬於一種打法（🐟 魚群、🌑 魚影、🦈 掠食魚、🪨 底棲魚、🦊 狡: Fighting styles: every fish has a style (🐟 School, 🌑 Shadow, 🦈 Predator, 🪨 Bottom, 🦊 Cunning, 🐋 Tuna), shown in the dex after your first catch; after 5 of the same fish the dex shows its ★ signature move and recommended rod. New moves: "🌀 Head shake" (sharks, bass, billfish) — the rod tip keeps shaking, so ease off briefly and then reel; forcing it the whole time loosens the hook. "〰️ Wriggle" (eels, sea snakes) — steer gently left and right in turn; pushing all the way makes it slip. Rare and legendary fish have their own ★ signature move that shows up more often and lasts longer; breaking it drains more stamina. When your rod matches the style (rock rod for bottom fish; Lure and Moonlight rods for shadow, predator and cunning fish; Surf and Deep Sea rods for tuna; hand rods for schools and cunning fish) you get 0.15 s more warning, correct moves drain ×1.3 stamina and mistakes cost half; a non-matching rod is just normal, never a penalty. The Golden King rod is medium at everything.
釣竿升級：四支專用竿（路亞、手竿、遠投、磯釣）可以在背包「🎣 釣組」升級，1～5: Rod upgrades: the four specialist rods (Lure, Pole, Surf, Rock) can be upgraded from Lv.1 to Lv.5 in Bag → 🎣 Tackle. Each level costs coins plus fish from your tank (Lv.2: 🪙800 + 3 common fish; Lv.3: 🪙2,000 + 2 rare fish; Lv.4: 🪙4,500 + 4 rare fish; Lv.5: 🪙9,000 + 1 legendary fish). The lightest fish in your tank are used; ⭐ starred and displayed fish are never taken. The first tap lists which fish will be used, tap again to confirm. Higher levels give more rare and legendary fish and a stronger line (Lv.5: rare ×1.5, legendary ×1.4). A Lv.4–5 specialist rod used in the right place on the right fish beats the King rod. A Lv.5 rod's tip sparkles when fighting its matching fish.

在自己小島的海底，點一下魚就會在上面顯示這條魚是誰、什麼時候、在哪裡釣到的，6: Under your own island, tap a fish to see who caught it, when and where. It hides again after 6 seconds (it no longer pops up just from swimming close).

排位獎勵：每天第一場排位勝利送 ✨ 亮光餌 ×5。每一季（每個月）第一次升到某個: Ranked rewards: your first ranked win each day gives ✨ Glow bait ×5.
